title: SWI Group Secures €800M From Institutions at €6.1B Valuation for Transatlantic AI Buildout
source_used: SWI Group press release on PR Newswire (original); Unite.AI relay also read (its byline is an AI-generated research agent)
key_facts: Euronext Amsterdam-listed SWI Group announced on 12 Oct 2026 an €800 million capital increase with institutional investors.
The company states a final valuation of €6.1 billion; new ordinary shares are issued in several series, taking total share capital to 558,399,385 shares.
Total equity raised since March 2026 is over €1 billion.
Proceeds are for data-centre and AI compute capacity, including power infrastructure and compute deployments, in Europe and the United States.
Free float rises to about 20%; certain investors received options conditional on equity capital markets milestones.
Founder and chief executive Max-Hervé George is quoted: the deal is about keeping up with the compute and data-centre markets.

Background from Unite.AI: in Aug 2026 SWI said more than 80% of its capital was allocated to a transatlantic digital-infrastructure platform with over 4 GW of combined power capacity, and it completed a controlling stake of more than 70% in Genesis Digital Assets (to be renamed SWI Digital).
quote_evidence: SINGAPORE and AMSTERDAM, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Euronext Amsterdam-listed SWI Group ("SWI"; SWICH) today announces an €800 million capital increase with institutional investors.
This increases the total equity raised since March 2026 to over €1 billion.
"This transaction is about keeping up to speed with the compute and data center markets.
why_it_matters_hint: Fresh equity for a listed company that is building data centres and AI computing capacity on both sides of the Atlantic.
notes: The original is the company's own press release (read on PR Newswire); Unite.AI relays it and adds earlier background. Status CONFIRMED means officially announced by the company; valuation and plans are the company's own statements, not independent findings.
